title: Time-R1: Post-Training Large Vision Language Model for Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Time-R1: Post-Training Large Vision Language Model for Temporal Video Grounding Temporal Video Grounding (TVG), the task of locating specific video segments based on language queries, is a core challenge in long-form video understanding.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Such capability is fundamental for real-world applications, including smart home assistants [60, 16, 49] and video retrieval systems on online platforms [5, 3].

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Inspired by recent success in reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training LLMs [41, 1] with chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, especially in domains with deterministic answers, such as code generation and mathematical reasoning, we explore whether RL can serve as an effective alternative for TVG.

methods.evidence_sentence: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Time-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple downstream datasets using significantly less training data than prior LVLM approaches, while improving its general video understanding capabilities.
